name: Login and protected request sequence
description: Successful login and protected identity request with explicit error alternatives. Global guard wiring is source evidence, not a deployed execution trace.
code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Account
    participant Auth as AuthController and AuthService
    participant DB as Prisma User and UserSession
    participant Guard as SessionAuthGuard and RolesGuard
    participant Users as UsersController
    Account->>Auth: POST /api/v1/auth/login
    Auth->>DB: Find normalized email and profile
    alt Missing user, bad password or inactive account
        Auth-->>Account: 401 credential error
    else Valid credentials
        Auth->>DB: Store token hash and expiry
        Auth-->>Account: Public user and session cookie
        Account->>Guard: GET /api/v1/me with cookie
        Guard->>DB: Find token hash and current user
        alt Session absent, revoked, expired or account inactive
            Guard-->>Account: 401
        else Valid session
            Guard->>Guard: Check required roles when declared
            Guard->>Users: Attach authenticated user
            Users-->>Account: Current user
        end
    end
verificationScope: Static behavior illustration, not an observed runtime trace.

name: Durable job transitions
description: Only JobsService/registered runner transitions shown. RUNNING self-transition is lease reclamation with new attempt; COMPLETED does not guarantee an audio artifact is READY.
code:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> PENDING: enqueue with schema default
    PENDING --> RUNNING: due and attempts below max
    RETRY_WAIT --> RUNNING: due and attempts below max
    RUNNING --> RUNNING: lease expired and attempts below max
    RUNNING --> FAILED: lease expired at max attempts
    RUNNING --> COMPLETED: matching owner and attempt succeeds
    RUNNING --> RETRY_WAIT: matching claim and eligible provider retry
    RUNNING --> FAILED: matching claim and no automatic retry
    FAILED --> PENDING: owner retry when retryable adds one attempt

name: Publication and explicit archive sequence
description: Preflight checks precede transaction locks, rereads and atomic materialization/pointer/audit/receipt updates.
code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Admin
    participant Publisher as ContentPublisherService
    participant DB as PostgreSQL transaction
    Admin->>Publisher: Publish import, revision, hash, key and audio choices
    Publisher->>DB: Read mutation receipt
    alt Matching replay receipt
        DB-->>Publisher: Saved response
        Publisher-->>Admin: Original response
    else New request
        Publisher->>Publisher: Check validated source and selected READY audio
        Publisher->>DB: Begin transaction and acquire lesson slug lock
        Publisher->>DB: Recheck receipt and row-lock import
        Publisher->>DB: Recheck revision, hash, validation and audio
        Publisher->>DB: Allocate version and materialize children
        Publisher->>DB: Bind selected audio
        Publisher->>DB: Archive prior current and publish new version
        Publisher->>DB: Change lesson pointer and import status
        Publisher->>DB: Write audit and receipt, commit
        Publisher-->>Admin: Published version identity
    end
    opt Explicit archive of published version
        Admin->>Publisher: Archive version
        Publisher->>DB: Slug lock and reread version
        Publisher->>DB: Archive, clear pointer if current, audit and commit
        Publisher-->>Admin: ARCHIVED
    end

nodeEvidence.DB: Prisma transaction and PostgreSQL lock calls

verificationScope: Static behavior illustration, not an observed runtime trace.

name: Durable audio generation activity
description: Handler returns STALE normally for script changes. Terminal/exhausted errors attempt artifact FAILED and rethrow for runner policy.
code:
flowchart TD
    Claim[GENERATE_AUDIO claim] --> Parse[Parse payload and fetch script]
    Parse --> Fresh{Script hash matches?}
    Fresh -->|No| Stale[Mark GENERATING artifact STALE]
    Fresh -->|Yes| Candidate[Resolve provider and GENERATING candidate]
    Candidate --> Synth[Synthesize and store audio]
    Synth --> Recheck{Latest script hash matches?}
    Recheck -->|Yes| Ready[Update artifact to READY]
    Recheck -->|No| Changed[Update artifact to STALE]
    Ready --> Result[Return status to runner]
    Changed --> Result
    Stale --> Result
    Candidate -.-> Err[Error caught in handler]
    Synth -.-> Err
    Err --> Terminal{Non-retryable or attempt budget exhausted?}
    Terminal -->|Yes| Failed[Attempt artifact FAILED]
    Terminal -->|No| Retain[Retain artifact state]
    Failed --> Throw[Rethrow to runner]
    Retain --> Throw

name: Sequence: writing submit, AI và retry
description: Sequence cho writing khi JobsService có sẵn. Session checkpoint tăng lúc enqueue; worker evaluation đến sau. Failed retry và terminal result không đồng nhất với session status.
code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Learner
    participant Sessions
    participant DB
    participant Jobs
    participant Handler
    participant Evaluation
    participant Provider
    participant Mastery
    Learner->>Sessions: submit writing with clientAttemptId
    Sessions->>DB: find owned session and attempt UUID
    alt same target UUID exists
        DB-->>Sessions: stored attempt
        Sessions-->>Learner: replay
    else new attempt at current checkpoint
        Sessions->>DB: transaction create raw response and QUEUED
        Sessions->>Jobs: enqueue EVALUATE_ATTEMPT in transaction
        Sessions->>DB: delete draft and CAS checkpoint
        Sessions-->>Learner: queued attempt
        Note over DB,Handler: Session may already be COMPLETED
        Handler->>DB: PROCESSING unless EVALUATED
        Handler->>Evaluation: evaluateAttempt
        Evaluation->>DB: lookup rubric result and input hash
        alt existing matching result
            DB-->>Evaluation: replay result
        else no result
            Evaluation->>Provider: evaluate with provenance
            alt success
                Evaluation->>DB: transaction result and EVALUATED
                opt mission purpose LEARNING
                    Evaluation->>Mastery: record scored evidence in transaction
                    Evaluation->>DB: project curriculum completion
                end
            else provider failure
                Handler->>DB: QUEUED if retry policy permits
                Note over Handler,DB: Otherwise EVALUATION_FAILED unless already EVALUATED
            end
        end
    end
    opt learner retries failed evaluation
        Learner->>Evaluation: retryForLearner
        Evaluation->>DB: check failed job and source availability
        Evaluation->>Jobs: retry owned retryable job
        Evaluation->>DB: failed attempt to QUEUED conditionally
    end

name: Mock: deadline, submit phần thi và terminal review
description: GET quá hạn tự submit một current section. Save trễ bị từ chối; submit section có thể sớm/trống. Report chỉ completed sau review.
code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Learner
    participant MockService
    participant DB
    actor Reviewer
    participant ReviewService
    Learner->>MockService: start mock with UUID and mode
    MockService->>DB: pin version, LISTENING, deadline plus 30 min
    Learner->>MockService: save responses with expectedRevision
    alt server now exceeds deadline
        MockService-->>Learner: 409 SECTION_EXPIRED
    else status and revision valid
        MockService->>DB: CAS merge current section responses
    end
    Learner->>MockService: get attempt
    opt IN_PROGRESS and now exceeds deadline
        MockService->>MockService: submit current section
        MockService->>DB: objective score if L or R, CAS next section and deadline
    end
    Note over MockService,DB: Order L 30, R 60, W 60, S 14 minutes
    loop remaining current sections
        Learner->>MockService: submit current section and revision
        MockService->>DB: CAS next section
    end
    MockService->>DB: final section to EVALUATION_PENDING
    Learner->>MockService: get report
    MockService-->>Learner: overall null, Writing and Speaking pending
    Reviewer->>ReviewService: rubric bands, expectedRevision and idempotencyKey
    Note over Reviewer,ReviewService: Controller roles CONTENT_ADMIN or SYSTEM_ADMIN
    ReviewService->>DB: advisory lock and receipt lookup
    alt matching receipt exists
        DB-->>ReviewService: replay completed report
    else new review
        ReviewService->>DB: require pending revision and objective scores
        ReviewService->>DB: transaction CAS COMPLETED, report, review, audit, receipt
    end
    Learner->>MockService: get report
    MockService->>DB: read reportSnapshot
    MockService-->>Learner: completed four-skill report

name: Speaking audio, transcript and evaluation data flow
description: Data-flow synthesis of the speaking transcription path. Binary audio is read through ObjectStorage, sent to the configured SpeechToTextPort, transcript and provider metrics are persisted on Recording, then an EVALUATE_ATTEMPT job is enqueued transactionally. EvaluationService reads the transcript as learnerResponse. This diagram omits upload and result persistence details; fake and external speech adapters are selected by configuration, not assumed live.
code:
flowchart LR
 Disk["ObjectStorage audio bytes"] -->|read storageKey| Handler["TranscribeSpeechHandler"]
 Handler -->|audio / mimeType / locale / referenceText| STT["Configured SpeechToTextPort"]
 STT -->|transcript / pronunciation / provider| Handler
 Handler -->|persist transcription| Recording[("Recording in PostgreSQL")]
 Handler -->|transactional enqueue| Job[("Job: EVALUATE_ATTEMPT")]
 Recording -->|transcript| Eval["EvaluationService: learnerResponse"]
 Job -. attemptId .-> Eval
